# HEM v0.6.2b9 — On-demand setting descriptions

- Home Options fields now place an information button at the right of the setting row, including checkbox, number, text and select fields. Descriptions are collapsed by default instead of permanently occupying space.
- Room source selectors use the same right-side help affordance in both the native Home Assistant form and fallback selector. Native forms no longer duplicate their description inline.
- Floor name, level, icon and room assignment controls also provide on-demand help. Existing Home/Room/Device native settings retain their right-aligned disclosure; unavailable metadata gets an honest no-additional-description fallback.
- Category summaries remain visible. Validation errors, unavailable-state messages, save progress and retry controls are not hidden as help.
- Help is keyboard accessible, has a setting-specific accessible name and expanded state, stays full-width on narrow screens and preserves its expansion through card/form refreshes. A help click never changes a checkbox, selection or setting, nor dispatches a service call.
- Preserve b7 direct autosave, pending-value protection, b8 Advanced/search behaviour, concise labels and door/Eco ordering. Search still includes collapsed help text.

Frontend only plus tests and release metadata. Humidity control, all other backend policies, PID/safety protections and Announcement Hub routing are unchanged. Update through HACS, follow its reload prompt and fully reload the dashboard. No server deployment, restart or appliance operation is performed by this release.
